title: A Dictator Is a Linear Threshold
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $i$ be one of its coordinates. The function that returns the sign of coordinate $i$ is a linear threshold function: there are a real bias and real coordinate weights such that, at every sign vector, the function equals $1$ when the resulting affine linear form is nonnegative and equals $-1$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $i$ is a coordinate among the $n$ coordinates
